many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until

def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c] and not seen[r][c]:
                col=g[r][c]; st=[(r,c)]; seen[r][c]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==col and not seen[x][y]:
                            seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                out.append((col,cells))
    return out

import json
# Rule per demos: remove sep row; template (bottom 1-comp(s)) shifts up 6, cols kept; identical top template copy merges;
# extras (non-2 comps not matching template pattern) place adjacent to template columns, side = above if extra<=template cell count else below (matches all 4 demos: d1 5<8 ab, d2 5=5 ab, d3 7>5 bw, d4 4<5?? -> but 4<5 should be ab; however observed below -> use color>=6 below / count: d4 4 vs template 5. Both fail d4... fallback: side = below for color 6,7; above else).
def solve(g):
    H=len(g);W=len(g[0]);S=None
    for r in range(H):
        if all(x==5 for x in g[r]):S=r;break
    ti=g[:S];bi=g[S+1:]
    def comps(g):
        H,W=len(g),len(g[0]);seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)];out=[]
        for r in range(H):
            for c in range(W):
                if g[r][c] and not seen[r][c]:
                    st=[(r,c)];seen[r][c]=True;cells=[]
                    while st:
                        a,b=st.pop();cells.append((a,b))
                        for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                            x,y=a+da,b+db
                            if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and g[x][y]==g[r][c] and not seen[x][y]:
                                seen[x][y]=True;st.append((x,y))
                    out.append(cells)
        return out
    ht=comps(ti);bt=comps(bi)
    tcells=[]
    for cs in bt: tcells+=cs
    nt=len(tcells)
    tr=min(r for r,c in tcells);tc=max(c for r,c in tcells);t0=min(c for r,c in tcells);tt=max(r for r,c in tcells)
    # normalized pattern set of template
    bpats=set()
    for cs in bt:
        m=min(r for r,c in cs);n0=min(c for r,c in cs)
        bpats.add(tuple(sorted((r-m,c-n0) for r,c in cs)))
    out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r,c in tcells:
        out[r-6][c]=1
    for cs in ht:
        col=cs[0][0]
        if col==2: continue
        m=min(r for r,c in cs);n0=min(c for r,c in cs)
        epat=tuple(sorted((r-m,c-n0) for r,c in cs))
        if epat in bpats: continue
        n=len(cs)
        # side: d1(5)ab,d2(5)ab,d3(7)bw,d4(4)bw -> try: below if color>=6 else above
        side='below' if col>=6 else 'above'
        rs=[r for r,c in cs];cs2=[c for r,c in cs]
        e1,e2,e3,e4=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs2),max(cs2)
        h_=e2-e1+1
        w_=e4-e3+1
        ce=(e1+e2)/2.0;cc=(t0+tc)/2.0
        dc=int(round(cc-ce))
        if side=='above':
            dr=e1-(tr+1)+... # top of extra = template_top -1 -> dr = (tr-6)-e1
            dr=(tr-6)-e1
        else:
            dr= (tt+1)-e2
        for r,c in cs:
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W: out[nr][nc]=col
    return out

G={k:v for k,v in G.items()}
ok=True
for n in [1,2,3,4]:
    got=solve(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']);exp=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    m=got==exp
    ok&=m
    if not m: print('demo',n,'fail');print(json.dumps(got));print(json.dumps(exp));ok=False
print('ALL:',ok)
grid=solve(G['Test input'])
print(json.dumps(grid))
